scope: core comparison workflow; optional analysis extensions and Phase 7 deferred

browser.selection: older Alpha v1 plus Beta v1; Alpha v2 excluded
checks: cell citations open selected historical version
reported context preserved and differing contexts flagged
downloaded artifacts parsed and source URLs matched
full matrix and same-version IDs valid
million units, EUR/USD, FY2024/FY2025 and scopes preserved
provider.limits: single provider adapter smoke, not broad end-to-end retrieval quality or cost validation

boundaries: workspace and source checks on all exports
unavailable-source content blocked, owned finding deletion allowed
mixed-workspace reset guard includes conversations and findings
chat history clears drafts and retains saved findings
not_done: optional calculations, regions and automated version-diff analysis
